Action: Abu Dhabi’s real estate transactions surged 112% year-on-year to hit Dh117 billion in the first half of this year, underpinned by strong foreign direct investment despite the fallout from the US-Iran war. The volume of deals rose 62%, with sales reaching Dh86.1 billion through 16,838 transactions in the six months ending in June, up almost 164% compared with the same period last year. Mortgages climbed by a third to Dh26.7 billion across 8,876 transactions, while FDI into the capital’s property sector more than quadrupled to Dh13.8 billion, already passing the total for the whole of 2025
